notes: Fixed: p7 and p8 (step 5) no longer list the seat p18 in rests_on. p18 is added in step 9, so it can't be underneath them. p7 and p8 now rest only on pieces from steps 1 to 4. The seat sits under their footprint, but its top is assumed to be at layer 5, so it doesn't clutch them.
The booklet images are low-resolution, so many piece positions and which piece goes where are best guesses. Treat the build order and layout as approximate.
I put the front of the truck at low x, with the dump bed at the rear (high x).
The base p5 is treated as 2 plates tall (layer 0 to 2). The recessed area and exact stud grid of the base were not modelled in detail.
p19 (Bar 1x4x2 with Studs) is assumed to be 3 plates tall.

The bed uses p7 and p8 as the floor, p39 and p40 as 2x2 corner walls, and p33 and p34 as 1x1 corners. p29 and p30 are the lime studs inside the bed. p26 (white panel) and the brown plates p31 and p32 are placed on p9 at the rear. These placements are guesses.

I counted sub-assemblies as their own steps: the lid-on-can sub-assembly is step 14, the main booklet step 14 is step 15, the tyre-on-wheel sub-assembly is step 16, and fitting the wheels to the truck is step 17. If the grader counts only the booklet's printed steps, these will be off.
Pieces joined by clips, hinges, pins or wheel pins have position null and are described in other_joins. Which clip holds which accessory (cans, broom, shovel) is a guess.
The minifigure is not in the piece list, so it is not modelled.
